Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: "shall thereafter delete all Customer Data from its systems"
"certify such deletion to Customer in writing"
"for a maximum period of six (6) months" exceeds 90 days
"Within thirty (30) days after expiration ... return to Customer all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format"

reasons: The single inserted Section 11.5 supplies the only absent preferred elements — 30-day return running from expiry or termination, standard machine-readable format, deletion after return, and written certification — while leaving Section 11.4's transition-assistance duration and then-current-rates mechanics untouched.

Transition assistance for up to six months at M&I's then-current rates already exists in Section 11.4, so no further edit was needed; the pre-existing 100-day request condition attaches only to the continuation of Services, not to the baseline Termination Assistance duty, and is a minor sub-element for the rationale rather than a deviation.

No undefined terms, contradictions or dangling mechanics are introduced: the insertion uses the defined "Customer Data" from Section 17.1 and is consistent with Customer's ownership there; Sections 17.1 and 17.5 remain fully effective.
Deletion and certification correctly follow return rather than preceding or replacing it, and the return deadline is not conditioned on a Customer request.
